findings.proof: Kind candidates reach nera_equal/nera_matches, which decode source text on each occurrence. The reference indexes values and matches distinct terms before seeking their postings.
findings.actualRule: data-layer-serverplan-target-architecture: literal identifier regex ^(?:step_tags)$ occurs in multiple AST branches.

findings.cause: Repeated SQL set operations and overmaterialization
findings.proof: 710 CTEs in one baseline final statement, 536 dynamic sorts in that statement; 164171085 VM steps and 2174 sorts over the complete two-batch candidate pipeline.
findings.fixed: Hash-cons identical generated relations and reuse implied/canonical intersections. Preserve exactness metadata separately. Fix A EXCEPT A under nested negation.

findings.proof: 2858925 BLOB reads and 519033 text extractions over 340517 indexed AST nodes. Most read bytes are repeated span blocks. CSE alone leaves most text decoding intact.
findings.next: Use value/vocabulary postings first, then share demanded decoded properties through SQL rather than repeatedly invoking scalar decoders.

findings.proof: An internal FTS cursor remains open across other statements. Its captured lifetime is 14.5 CPU seconds although the complete profiled cold phase uses 2.5466 CPU seconds. These are not additive exclusive execution costs.
findings.fixed: Direct timers around prepare/materialize/results/index/cleanup; report suppresses CPU priorities when statement lifetime totals cannot reconcile with the apply CPU budget.

externalSample.classificationNote: Exclusive stack categories over one two-second sampling window. FTS classification wins before BLOB and sorting; other includes VM dispatch and generic B-tree work. Not an exact whole-process CPU split.

staticRedundancy.note: Static statement occurrences, not dynamic execution counts. Recognizes only intersections of identical named sets.

algebra-red.purpose: TDD: reproduce missing relation reuse and redundant intersections before the implementation

limitations: API before/after causal measurements use matched opt-level=0 engine builds, with SQLite dependencies unchanged. They establish work counts and attribution, not production CPU totals.
Production comparisons use opt-level=1 before/after builds, three serial fresh processes per version and workload, matching policy/workload digests and passing parity.
Whole repository and ten-rule performance is not established by these bounded controls.
Value indexing is identified and motivated here; it has not been implemented.
Intermediate relation reuse improves CPU on the positive control but does not resolve memory or decoding costs.
